mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM Manufacturing Index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 45, it signals a contraction in industrial activity that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 45 but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over 3 months, exceeding 0.5 percentage points, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE 3-month change > 0.5pp but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive > 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise by more than 10% year-over-year while the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2%, it signals a housing-led economic boom that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: early-cycle expansion with easy monetary policy
failure_condition: HOUST y-o-y change > 10% and FEDFUNDS < 2% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) over 6 months, exceeding 4%, signals a wage-price spiral that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: 6-month CPIAUCSL change > 4% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by less than 100,000 jobs per month for 3 consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 3-month PAYEMS change < 100,000 but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When real estate loans (RSAFS) grow by more than 10% year-over-year while the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals a credit-fueled demand boom that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: mid-cycle expansion with loose credit conditions
failure_condition: RSAFS y-o-y change > 10% and UNRATE < 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) and payroll employment (PAYEMS) both decline month-over-month, it signals a broad-based economic contraction that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO and PAYEMS both decline m-o-m but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive > 50% of the time.
